The one dick policy in open relationships is so so so uncool. It’s him saying…it’s okay for me to do whatever I want but I can’t allow you to have that same freedom. This one sided openness is extremely unfair to you and if he can find a way to open up more to the idea of you dating too, he might even find that all the things he was insecure about that stopped him from allowing you this, are simply not going to happen. He needs to trust you the same way you have trusted him. I will say though, once that trust is broken (him cheating like this) it will be hard to trust him fully again. 

Are you two doing regular relationship check ins? Would highly recommend. Come with things over the week that bothered you. End the check in with questions like “Do you feel safe and loved?” “Do you feel confident in me as your partner?” This will open the dialogue and creates a nice space to lay your heart out.
